In late summer of 812 AR the Ember river thinned, then stopped. Fishermen at the Dry Bend walked the bed before noon. By evening the mud had a skin on it.

[[Ember Reach]] did not empty. [[Riverfolk]] are stubborn about places they have already named. The willow docks became a bridge over nothing. [[The Ashwardens]] kept the lodge hearths invited and lit.

The next year, [[Mira Vale]] began her survey. She marks the Dry Bend with a broken line, the way some people write a name they are not ready to stop using.
